strength: The free plan includes templates and basic editing for YouTube, TikTok, and Reels.
weakness: Pro is $19.99 per month, and this is an editor rather than a tool that clips a connected Twitch channel.
smokeTestNotes: Official site and pricing page were fetched. No account was created.
name: CapCut
shortDescription: Video editor for YouTube, TikTok, and Reels. Pricing lists Free and Pro at $19.99/month.
longDescription: CapCut is a video editor for short-form and social video. On October 16, 2026 the pricing page listed Free at $0, with free templates and basic editing tools, and Pro at $19.99 per month. We did not install the app.
freeTierNotes: Free templates and basic editing tools.
bestFor: Editing a YouTube video or a short for TikTok and Reels
Creators who want templates and captions in one editor
notIdealFor: Clipping a Twitch VOD automatically from a connected channel
